error.signature: AI tells someone that Systembolaget has an absolute, exception-free retail monopoly on alcohol above 3.5% ABV in Sweden, with no way to buy directly from a producer

verdict.summary: Systembolaget remains the only retailer allowed to sell alcoholic drinks above roughly 3.5% ABV (grocery stores may sell folkol up to that threshold). Since Sweden's Riksdag approved Proposition 2024/25:86 on 23 April 2025 - effective 1 June 2025 for an initial six-year period through 31 May 2031 - small-scale independent producers may additionally sell directly to visitors who first complete a paid, producer-run educational (kunskapshojande) event, up to per-visit limits of 0.7 L spirits, 3 L wine, and 3 L strong beer or other fermented drinks. This is a narrow, opt-in, time-limited carve-out - not a repeal of the monopoly, which the reform is explicitly designed to preserve.

dead_ends.action: Tell someone that alcohol above 3.5% ABV can only ever be bought at Systembolaget in Sweden, with literally no exceptions, including at wineries, breweries, or distilleries
dead_ends.why_fails: Riksdagen's Social Committee (Betankande 2024/25:SoU24) backed the government's proposition to allow small-scale farm sales (gardsforsaljning) effective 1 June 2025: producers may sell directly to visitors who have attended a paid educational event at the production site, within per-visit quantity caps. The exception is time-limited to six years and was designed - per the government's own January 2025 announcement - specifically so 'the retail monopoly is protected' overall, not so it disappears.
dead_ends.condition: Visiting a small-scale Swedish alcohol producer directly
dead_ends.common_misconception: That the Systembolaget monopoly is a blanket, permanent rule with zero point-of-production exceptions.

workarounds.action: Confirm the specific producer actually holds a gardsforsaljning permit and requires attendance at a paid educational event before any on-site sale; otherwise buy their products through Systembolaget or a licensed restaurant as before
workarounds.how: The farm-sale exception is opt-in per producer, capped by annual production volume, restricted to weekdays 10:00-20:00 and Saturdays 10:00-15:00 (no Sunday farm sales), and prices must cover production cost plus a reasonable markup rather than undercut Systembolaget.
workarounds.condition: Wanting to buy directly from a Swedish alcohol producer
